subject: science
description: Classify igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks, trace the rock cycle, apply the Law of Superposition, and use radioactive half-lives to date rock samples for UPCAT.
learningObjectives: Classify rocks as igneous (intrusive/extrusive), sedimentary, or metamorphic and give examples
Describe how rocks transform between types in the rock cycle
Apply the Law of Superposition to determine relative ages of rock layers
Calculate the age of a rock sample using radioactive half-life decay
